blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senators Imee Marcos and Robinhood Padilla have filed a resolution urging the government to secure the release and repatriation of former President Rodrigo Duterte from the International Criminal Court (ICC) and halt enforcement of the arrest warrant against Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa. Duterte is detained in The Hague, Netherlands, over charges of crimes against humanity before the ICC, while dela Rosa remains in hiding amid reports of an ICC arrest warrant against him for his alleged role in Duterte’s bloody drug war.
